questions.q: With the page defaults $A = (3, 4)$ and $B = (4, -2)$, what is $A + B$?
questions.explain: Add matching components: $(3+4,\; 4+(-2)) = (7, 2)$. $(12,-8)$ multiplies instead of adds.

questions.q: With the same vectors, what is $A - B$?
questions.explain: $A - B = A + (-B) = (3-4,\; 4-(-2)) = (-1, 6)$. Watch the double negative in the second component.

questions.q: Geometrically, where does the arrow $A - B$ go when both $A$ and $B$ start at the origin?
options: From the tip of $A$ to the tip of $B$
From the tip of $B$ to the tip of $A$
From the origin to the midpoint of $A$ and $B$
questions.explain: Since $B + (A - B) = A$, the difference is the arrow you add to $B$ to reach $A$: tip of $B$ → tip of $A$. The reversed direction would be $B - A$.

questions.q: In the tip-to-tail picture, what does subtracting $B$ do to the second leg of the flight?
options: It flips $B$ to point the opposite way, then adds it
It shortens $B$ to half its length
questions.explain: Subtracting a vector is adding its opposite: $A - B = A + (-B)$, so the orange arrow flips before being attached to the tip of $A$.
